system.abilityReq: Adamant Circle Sorcery / Obsidian Circle Necromancy
system.description: As Emerald Circle Feedback (Power 3), save that this works against the Sapphire Circle as the earlier version does against Emerald, and automatically prevents the use of Emerald Circle Sorcery and thaumaturgy. An alternate version cripples necromancy of the Labyrinth Circle and below.
